what_was_found: The merge was refused by the repository rule that every review conversation be resolved: the automated reviewer had raised three findings on Central's portal-certificate service, each confirmed in the code.
P1: switching the ACME directory (the documented staging -> production step) left staging certificates ISSUED, so appliances would serve browser-untrusted certificates until their ordinary renewal.
P1: an appliance could be deleted while Central's portal-certificate configuration was incomplete, cascading away the rows its published A record and certificates are cleaned up from.
P2: changing the DNS zone while hostnames exist would strand them where the zone-scoped token can no longer reach.
delivered: Leaving a directory marks every certificate it issued due at once; ARI is consulted only for the current directory; 'new' for the weekly cap is per directory.
CanRelease refuses a deletion before anything is revoked when cleanup is pending and Central cannot perform it.
A zone change with live hostnames is refused (409 zone_in_use).
Regression steps in the Pebble integration test (PASS); control-plane suite PASS.
